action_summary: Six measured §5 iterations on the own-weights, zero-model, external-store boundary: (1) one executed run in a new environment closes a residual goal class with one judgment and exact held-out replay; (2) a 75-run/163-sequence/1.84 s fit buys the same correctness as the 555-run/2,484-sequence/148.99 s fit; (3) a carried relation honestly refuses on a goal whose terms do not recompute, while N3 is falsified; (4) the same loop on a second goal fails P3 with four named false rejects; (5) a computed deictic holder-shape relation fixes those witnesses and transfers across identity names but refuses a changed content literal; (6) a computed content:first_relocation_source pointer removes both identity and content literals, fits three literal-free statements, collapses them with two real delayed-run judgments, and predicts 258/258 on each of two held-out machines with both kinds of literal changed. All 21 unique primary-source pages were read through their final chunk (81 distinct chunk reads). 23 new tests pass; no capability credit, independent verification or §6 completion is claimed.
